opponents.name: Police Constable Floyd
opponents.meet_text: Because we've just reopened the forest, my boss wants us to keep a patrol to keep an eye out for any trouble.
opponents.repeat_text: Have you seen anything suspicious recently?
opponents.first_win_text: It's a good thing this area is so safe.
opponents.loss_text: I should be promoted to detective!

opponents.name: Police Sergeant Douglas
opponents.meet_text: You better not be up to anything. I'm the searge round ere. I'm keeping my eyes out for anything that aint right.
opponents.repeat_text: We're lucky nothing ever really happens round these parts.
opponents.first_win_text: Report back to me if you see anything dodgy immediately.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Don't tell anyone I'm rubbish at this.
opponents.loss_text: There'll be no crime around here on my watch.

opponents.name: Psychic Eli
opponents.meet_text: I can teach you to unleash your hidden potential. You have to be ready to empty your mind, focus and concentrate.
opponents.repeat_text: I am now able speak to you through your mind without the need to talk.
opponents.first_win_text: You have the power. Focus. Direct. Start small and train hard.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You have great potential. I think you have what it takes.
opponents.loss_text: I was wrong. You lack the discipline it takes.

opponents.name: Ghost Whisperer Vera
opponents.meet_text: This forest is haunted. I am here to speak with those from the past.
opponents.repeat_text: Hope you haven't joined any gangs.
opponents.first_win_text: Someone is looking over your shoulder.
opponents.rematch_win_text: The spirits must be guiding you.
opponents.loss_text: I was getting help from the other side.

opponents.name: Veteran Sylvester
opponents.meet_text: We've travelled the world together and settled here recently. We've been aboard the SS Anne before and it looks like it hasn't changed in years.
opponents.repeat_text: Good evening, hope you're keeping well.
opponents.first_win_text: You already appear well travelled. Maybe you could join us on our next adventure.
opponents.loss_text: Don't let this get you down.

opponents.name: Card Expert Aurora
opponents.meet_text: The weather here is always good but I love a good storm.
opponents.repeat_text: I might take a trip to somewhere colder.
opponents.first_win_text: You won't need an umbrella then.
opponents.loss_text: You'll never be ready for a true storm.

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Lt. Surge
opponents.meet_text: Hey Kid, you're in for a shock if you think you can beat me at the Gym Challenge. You'll need to hold your nerve against me. I'm using the Gym Challenge rules, so don't think about using any banned trainer cards.
opponents.first_win_text: Even my electric tricks lost. You're good at this.
opponents.rematch_win_text: When it comes to Electric type Pokemon, I'm number one. Card games? Clearly not so much hahaha.

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Koga
opponents.meet_text: Fwahaha! I am Koga. I was part of the Elite Four but most importantly an Ex Gym Leader. My style will confound and destroy you! Confusion, sleep, poison... Prepare to be the victim of my sinister technique!
opponents.repeat_text: I, too, must pursue further discipline.
opponents.first_win_text: Humph! You have proven your worth!
opponents.rematch_win_text: I subjected you to everything I could muster. But my efforts failed. I must hone my skills
opponents.loss_text: Have you learned to fear the techniques of the ninja?

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Sabrina
opponents.meet_text: I had a vision of your arrival! My name is Sabrina. I have had psychic powers since I was a child. You're here to play against me. I will grant you a match.
opponents.repeat_text: I knew you would return and this too shall not be the last time we meet.
opponents.first_win_text: This loss shocks me! But a loss is a loss. I admit I didn't work hard enough to win.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Your power... It far exceeds what I foresaw... Maybe it isn't possible to fully predict what the future holds...
opponents.loss_text: This turned out exactly as I had predicted.

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Blaine
opponents.meet_text: Hah! I'm Blaine! I was the Leader of Cinnabar Gym before it burned down in the volcanic eruption. I retired but I'm here to help run this challenge. You won't be able to use certain trainers in your deck if you're taking part.
opponents.repeat_text: I'll never give up until I win.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I have burned down to nothing! Not even ashes remain!
opponents.loss_text: My fiery Pokémon will incinerate all challengers!

opponents.name: Ex Gym Leader Giovanni
opponents.meet_text: I shall spare you a moment of my time. I am the ex Gym Leader Giovanni. I believe Team Rocket has arrived but I know nothing of their plans. I am merely here for the Gym Hero Challenge.
opponents.repeat_text: Two things are inevitable: my success and your failure.
opponents.loss_text: Mark my words. Not being able to measure your own strength shows that you are still but a child.
